results.title: 'He's a machine!' - Arsenal legend Martin Keown hails 'legendary' Gabriel and names Premier League's best defensive duo
results.description: Arsenal icon Martin Keown has heaped praise on Gabriel Magalhaes following the Gunners' commanding Premier League victory over Everton. The Brazilian defender was labelled a "legend of the football club" as Mikel Arteta's side moved level on points with Manchester City at the top of the table.
